name: CivicPulse Vote Impactfulness Formula
nonpartisan_guarantee: Scores are 100% deterministic and never use political ideology, party, or subjective AI opinions. Anyone can recompute the exact score from the tally.
plain_english_summary: Every local measure receives a 0 to 100 score by adding three objective components: (1) Legal Weight (10-40 pts) based on whether it changes permanent law or budgets, (2) Contestedness (0-40 pts) based on how close the Yes/No vote margin was, and (3) Turnout (0-20 pts, capped at 10 pts for subcommittees) based on how many members of that body participated.
equation: ImpactScore = min(100, LegalWeight + ((1 - |Yes - No| / (Yes + No)) * 40) + ((VotesCast / BodySize) * TurnoutCap))

parameters.pivotal_vote_rule: Winning-side vote where |yes_count - no_count| <= 1 (or <= 2 on supermajority/split decisions).

changelog.summary: Published full plain-English & machine-readable formula specification; fixed committee attendance/turnout denominator so committee votes are scored against committee size rather than full-council size; added deterministic formula hash for change detection.
Standardized 3-factor deterministic model: Legal Weight (10-40 pts) + Contestedness / Vote Margin (0-40 pts) + Body Turnout (0-20 pts).
Initial prototype heuristic combining event type and yes/no closeness.
